messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
截至我最後一次更新（2023 年底），男子 ATP 世界排名第一的是 **Novak Djokovic**。  
女子 WTA 世界排名第一則是 **Iga Świątek**。  

請注意，ATP/WTA 排名每週都會根據比賽結果調整，若您需要最新的即時排名，建議查閱官方網站或使用專門的體育數據 API。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" (Who is currently ranked number one tennis player?). We need to retrieve current ranking. Use function sports_team_standing? That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual ranking. We can answer based on knowledge: For men's tennis ATP ranking, as of 2026? Actually current year 2026. But we don't have up-to-date data. We can approximate: As of 2023, Novak Djokovic was top. But 2026 unknown. We might say "I don't have real-time data." But we can provide general answer: "As of my last update, Novak Djokovic is ranked number one." But we should note that rankings change weekly. So answer accordingly.
